t: What Plasma Behavior Database Is All About
title: What Plasma Behavior Database Is All About
description: Plasma is the fourth state of matter: gas hot enough that electrons tear free, leaving charged particles that respond to magnetic fields. The sun's core is plasma at 15 million K; a tokamak confines plasma at 100+ million K with magnetic fields. The Lawson criterion sets the bar for fusion: density × confinement time × temperature must exceed ~3e21 keV·s/m³ for deuterium-tritium. This database is the complete plasma phenomenon: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.

t: Core Vocabulary of Plasma Behavior Database
title: Core Vocabulary of Plasma Behavior Database
description: Every field has its own language. These are the working terms of Plasma Behavior Database — learn them first and every later record reads faster: plasma: ionized gas of free electrons and ions; confinement time: how long energy stays in the plasma; triple product: n·τ·T, the fusion progress metric; ELM: edge-localized mode, a plasma edge instability.
definition: The working vocabulary of Plasma Behavior Database: the terms practitioners actually use.
key_points: plasma: ionized gas of free electrons and ions
confinement time: how long energy stays in the plasma
triple product: n·τ·T, the fusion progress metric
ELM: edge-localized mode, a plasma edge instability
Debye length: plasma's electric screening distance
breakeven: fusion energy out equals heating energy in
